caption: The drawing features a doll-like figure made of simple forms and materials, predominantly colored in light beige and pale pink shades. The central figure is constructed with an oval head wrapped in a textured material, possibly cloth, with a pink ribbon and bow around the head. The body consists of straight cylindrical arms (colored dark brown and wrapped in a cloth) and a long, flowing light-colored dress with a frilled bottom. To the left, a simplified version of the figure is shown with minimal clothing, indicating the underlying structure. On the right side of the drawing, six separate clothing items are sketched: a short-sleeved dress or blouse, an apron or skirt, an elongated piece resembling a sash or scarf, a triangular kerchief, a frilled collar or sleeve, and a small rounded bonnet or cap with a bow. The lines are rendered in pencil or fine ink, with selective use of subtle color shading for emphasis, primarily in the clothing and ribbons. The background of the drawing is plain, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Doll
